title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain D'Youville University
description: Explore the essential late-night destinations for D'Youville University students, from on-campus study hubs and fitness centers to iconic Buffalo eateries that stay open long after the sun sets.

cards.title: Kuhrt Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Saints Center
cards.notes: Located in the Saints Center, this food court is the primary on-campus spot for dinner and evening socializing before late study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus dining hub for students in the Saints Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Kuhrt Dining Hall is located in the Saints Center and serves as a primary dining location for students.
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner during the academic year; check seasonal hours for specific closing times.

cards.title: D'Youville Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: D'Youville Academic Center
cards.notes: Open until 10:00 PM on weekdays, this facility allows students to squeeze in a late-night workout on the 6th floor or in the basement.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level campus fitness facility open late for student wellness.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center is open Monday through Friday from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Monday-Friday; requires valid student ID for entry.

cards.title: Jim's Steakout
cards.subtitle: Elmwood Village
cards.notes: A Buffalo staple famous for the Stinger sub, this location stays open until 4:00 AM on weekends for the ultimate late-night meal.
cards.short_summary: Iconic Buffalo sub shop known for late-night service and signature steak subs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elmwood Village location is open until 4:00 AM Thursday through Saturday and 2:00 AM Sunday through Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 4:00 AM on weekends; walk-in orders accepted until closing.

cards.title: Mighty Taco
cards.subtitle: Delaware Ave
cards.notes: A regional favorite for quick Mexican-style fare, serving the campus community with late-night tacos and burritos.
cards.short_summary: Buffalo's homegrown taco chain and a frequent late-night stop for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Mighty Taco is a Buffalo institution known for catering to late-night crowds since 1973.
cards.access_notes: Check specific location for daily late-night hours; typically open past midnight.

cards.title: Kavinoky Theatre
cards.subtitle: Porter Ave
cards.notes: This professional theatre on campus hosts evening performances and post-show discussions that extend into the night.
cards.short_summary: An intimate professional theatre located on the D'Youville campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kavinoky Theatre hosts evening performances at 7:30 PM with post-show discussions on selected nights.
cards.source_title: A Night with Janis Joplin — D'Youville Kavinoky Theatre
cards.access_notes: Evening showtimes typically start at 7:30 PM; check schedule for specific event dates.

cards.title: Elmwood Taco and Subs (ETS)
cards.subtitle: Elmwood Ave
cards.notes: Known as ETS, this local favorite is open until 2:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays for tacos and Buffalo-style subs.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night spot for Mexican fare and subs in the Elmwood Village.
cards.evidence_claim: ETS is open until 2:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Montante Family Library
cards.subtitle: D'Youville Campus
cards.notes: The primary research and study hub on campus, offering quiet spaces and group study rooms for late-night academic work.
cards.short_summary: The university's main library and a key destination for evening study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The library provides study spaces and room reservations for students.
cards.access_notes: Check the university website for current semester hours; typically open late during finals.

cards.title: Wellness Lodge
cards.subtitle: KAB 3rd Floor
cards.notes: A dedicated space for students to relax and reset with evening events like yoga and meditation to de-stress from classes.
cards.short_summary: A campus sanctuary for student relaxation and mental wellness activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Lodge on the 3rd floor of KAB hosts events including yoga and meditation.
cards.access_notes: Check the campus events calendar for evening wellness sessions.

cards.title: Papi Grande's Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Maple Rd
cards.notes: A popular spot for evening dining and social gatherings, offering a variety of Mexican dishes and a lively atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A vibrant Mexican restaurant frequently visited by students for evening meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Papi Grande's is open for dinner 7 days a week and offers delivery until 9:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for dinner; delivery and pickup options available late into the evening.

cards.title: Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Saints Center
cards.notes: Located in the Saints Center, this arena provides a high-tech space for late-night gaming and competitive esports practice.
cards.short_summary: The university's dedicated facility for competitive and recreational gaming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Esports Arena is located in the Saints Center, which also houses the athletic program and dining hall.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during scheduled arena hours; check with Student Engagement for late-night access.
